prompt: The adapter now uses a private service URL as its server credential. Finish this integration so session responses, history, stream events and diagnostic outputs do not expose that credential. Preserve server authentication and all unrelated response data. Use the smallest complete change, keep provider.py unchanged, and run python3 test_adapter.py. No network, real credentials, dependencies, or git commits.

evaluation.scope: Synthetic JSON output-boundary simulation; verifies that input authentication stays intact while credential URLs are removed from every outbound form. No real service, network, credentials or time dependency.

rubric.criterion: Remove credential-bearing URL occurrences from session, history, stream and diagnostics.
Keep the original URL for server authentication and preserve unrelated fields and public URLs without changing the provider.
